title: Intelligent Terrain
description: The program centres on land-based knowledge, patterns of natural ecology, and digital landscapes to explore the implications of algorithmic systems, automation, machine sensing, and displacement, exile, and migration across digital and physical borders. Intelligent Terrain is an exploration of art-based land regeneration and ecological storytelling. Co-produced with UKAI Projects and Ferme Lanthorn (Wakefield, Quebec); funded by the Canada Council for the Arts Digital Greenhouse.

title: Goblin Market
description: A post-scarcity festival framework that reappropriates "rituals of commerce" for fostering generosity, collaboration, and transformation. Organized around three pillars — Circular Mentorship, Prototyping Abundance (this is also where the homepage's "Prototyping Alternative Arts Marketplace" mention belongs, rather than a separate entry), and Art in Every Neighbourhood. Co-creators include Abbey Richens, Adrian Layner, Amelia Winger-Bearskin, annais linares, Emil Woudenberg, Luisa Ji, and Tricia Enns.

title: Cultural Technologies Lab
description: A community of practice reclaiming culture as a dynamic force for resilience rather than as a passive reflection of existing power structures.

title: Poetics of Synthetic Language
